Privacy policy

How tool values, analytics, ads and consent are handled.

Tool data

Item, box, weight and divisor values are calculated in the browser. This site does not transmit or store those values on a Vijeron server.

Analytics

Google Analytics 4 may record page views and tool-use events. Tool events include only the tool name and language, without input or result numbers.

Ads and consent

AdSense and Funding Choices code may load on content pages. Ad and analytics storage start denied until applicable consent choices are obtained. Google may process data under its service policies.

Contact

Use Vijeron's contact page for privacy questions or corrections.

Measured Packaging

Geometry planning tools, not a rate quote, packaging certification or delivery guarantee.
